claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: O-1918 is a cannabidiol analog that acts as an antagonist at the atypical endothelial cannabinoid/GPR18 receptor and does not bind CB1/CB2; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, with no plausible killing mechanism at this concentration.
